# MineBench

> MineBench is a desktop mining benchmark client with public CPU/GPU results and a live mining pool dashboard.

The client is free to download. Premium is an optional one-time upgrade for custom Monero wallet and pool settings with no expiry. CPU tuning controls are also available in the free client. Benchmark submissions and pool rewards are different: a benchmark is not proof of earnings. Release availability is listed on the downloads page.

## Product and setup
- [MineBench overview](https://minebench.cloud/): Product overview, first benchmark steps, and questions about results.
- [Downloads](https://minebench.cloud/downloads): Available release files by operating system and architecture.
- [Premium](https://minebench.cloud/premium): Current Premium features, one-time price, additional SOL fees, and upgrade requirements.
- [Pricing in plain text](https://minebench.cloud/pricing.txt): The same public offer in a text format.

## Public data and documentation
- [Hardware leaderboard](https://minebench.cloud/leaderboard): Highest submitted positive average hashrate per device name, from different systems and test conditions.
- [Live dashboard](https://minebench.cloud/dashboard): Current network and benchmark activity.
- [Whitepaper](https://minebench.cloud/whitepaper): Project model and technical background.
- [Mining benchmark guides](https://minebench.cloud/guides): Practical guides for RandomX benchmarking, hashrate efficiency, and download verification.
- [DePIN overview](https://minebench.cloud/depin): MineBench's current compute and infrastructure capabilities and planned distributed network work.
- [RandomX benchmarking guide](https://minebench.cloud/guides/randomx-benchmarking): How to run and interpret a repeatable CPU mining benchmark.
- [Hashrate per watt guide](https://minebench.cloud/guides/measure-hashrate-per-watt): How to measure mining efficiency without treating it as a profit guarantee.
- [Mining profitability calculator inputs](https://minebench.cloud/guides/mining-profitability-calculator): Inputs and limitations to check before estimating mining profitability.
- [Download verification guide](https://minebench.cloud/guides/verify-minebench-download): How to verify the official client download and investigate security warnings.
- [Client source and releases](https://bitbucket.org/minebenchapp/minebench-client): Public Bitbucket repository.

## Support
- [MineBench Discord](https://discord.gg/vsDyYh4rma): Setup and upgrade support.

Benchmark results describe measured conditions and are not earnings, profitability, safety, or performance guarantees. Current releases, supported platforms, pricing, and live data should be verified on the linked canonical pages.
